name: selected_route_id
description: The unique identifier for the SelectedRoute resource. Logical primary key. Pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'.

name: display_name
description: User-provided descriptive name for the route. Intended for human readability.

name: record_time
description: The UTC timestamp representing when the road data was collected, fully reconstructed from retrieval_time seconds and nanos with microsecond precision.

name: duration_in_seconds
description: The near real-time traffic-aware duration of the route in seconds.

name: static_duration_in_seconds
description: The traffic-unaware (static) duration of the route in seconds, representing estimated travel time under free-flow conditions.

name: route_geometry
description: The actual optimal path determined by the routing engine as a native BigQuery GEOGRAPHY polyline object (EPSG:4326).

name: road_segment_ids
description: Place IDs along the route in topological order indicating connected road segments.

name: speed_reading_intervals
description: Repeated RECORD containing road sub-segments categorized by traffic speed boundaries.

fields.name: interval_coordinates
fields.description: The native GEOGRAPHY representation of the specific road segment for this speed interval, constructed as a standard EPSG:4326 line string.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The categorical classification of speed for this interval. Possible values: 'NORMAL', 'SLOW', 'TRAFFIC_JAM'.
